newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan police investigate gruesome haul.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan police investigate gruesome haul.

text.p: Venezuelan police on Friday were investigating a gruesome haul of body parts and foetuses discarded from a hospital that were uncovered at a rubbish dump near the capital.

The eight adult bodies and 10 foetuses in 24 plastic bags found on Thursday have been traced to the pathology lab of a university hospital in Caracas, said Alberto Ramirez, head of the police murder squad.
"We are going to continue investigating to identify the bodies," and why they were not incinerated, Ramirez said.
Witnesses said city garbage trucks had dumped the bags at the refuse ground 25 miles (40 km) east of the capital on Thursday.
One local who lives from scavenging among the garbage described the discovery: "One of the bags was opened and the head of an old man appeared," he said.
